text:
Aisha: FYI vendor (PolarFreight) sent amended invoice for PO-90111 (H100 replacements). FX moved ~6.8% and they added a pass-through currency handling fee. RMA line +broker now shows +€16,200 vs original. Need quick cost decision.
Ben: Can you paste the line-level diffs?
Aisha: Sure: ```parts_usd: $950,000; fx_adj: +$64,600 (~6.8%); currency_fee: $4,900; rma_air_orig: $11,800 -> rma_air_new: $28,900 (air+broker+customs)```
Ravi: Are we talking full swap or only DOA batch?
Aisha: 12 DOA units + 8 partial swaps = 20 total. Vendor split charges: replacement SKUs (warranty), logistics (pass-through).
Dana (Finance): Quick Q 11: Does vendor policy cover FX on warranty items?
Aisha: Vendor stance: warranty covers parts manufacturing only; freight and FX are buyer-responsible. They offered a shared expedite cost if we accept consolidated shipment.
Ben: Consolidated AWB sounds good to reduce per-entry brokerage. Also ask for depot handover photos and scanned MANIFEST.
Ravi: Ops tradeoffs: Option 1: Air now (expedite), share cost 50/50, ETA 48-72h, our outlay ~€8,100. Option 2: Use spare pool + sea for non-critical units (LCL) ETA +11-13d, save on freight but take FX hit on parts (~€64.6k). Option 3: Push vendor for EUR invoice for RMA lines (they may accept for next PO only).
Dana (Finance): Finance can approve up to €9k from contingency for expedite. Anything >€9k needs director sign-off.
Ben: Is EU pool able to cover immediate demand?
Aisha: EU dedicated pool has 4 N+ spares; APAC tight. We can cover 12 of 20 for ~10 days without risk.
Ravi: SRE: if we shift compute from eu-edge-01 to eu-edge-05 and spin ephemeral guests, we can mask 48h of degradation. Can SRE confirm no canary fallout?
SREBot: Alert: eu-edge-01 degraded 3 GPUs at 09:26 UTC; ticket INF-4732 created. Canary window requested 23:00-01:00 UTC for traffic shift.
Ravi: Good. If we accept air, logistics ask: (a) consolidated AWB, (b) vendor uses our broker under DDP for half the units, (c) vendor provides depot handoff photos + carrier POD.
Aisha: I asked vendor: "We can accept 50/50 expedite provided you consolidate AWBs, use our broker for half (NordSea Logistics), and waive the currency_fee on RMA freight lines." Waiting reply.
vendor-account: "We can consolidate AWBs and use NordSea, but cannot waive the currency fee. We can offer €3.5k credit and will invoice in EUR for next PO only"
Dana (Finance): With €3.5k vendor credit + our €9k contingency we cover air option within ~€12.5k band. Approve up to €9k now; director needed beyond.
Ben: Operational plan if air accepted: 1) split forwarder usage (NordSea for 10 units, vendor forwarder for rest), 2) route customs entries with single HS line per SKU, 3) request expedited customs broker window to avoid demurrage.
Ravi: If vendor stalls we escalate to vendor-relations and request DDP billing with vendor absorbing broker fees.
Aisha: Vendor replied: "Consolidation confirmed, NordSea accepted for 10 units, offering €3.5k credit, currency_fee stands." They asked for our sign-off within 4 hours to hit the carrier cut.
Dana (Finance): I'll provision €9k contingent approval. Maria? (typo) Aisha: Please update PO amendment and capture vendor credit line.
Ben: I'll draft shipping instruction and AWB template; will post in #vendors-shipping for review.
Ravi: SRE will schedule canary window 23:00-01:00 UTC, standby for confirmation.
Aisha: Action items: @Ben post AWB draft; @Ravi enact spare reassign for 12 units; @Dana finalize contingency approval; @vendor-account send consolidated AWB + manifest.
Ben: Posted AWB draft and routing plan in #vendors-shipping.
SREBot: INF-4732 state updated: canary scheduled 23:00-01:00 UTC.
Aisha: Thanks 11 tagging @vendor-relations if vendor backtracks. :shipit:
